train: Even pattern lengths 16..96; random prefix 0..64 and gap 0..64; random symbols with replacement
format: prefix, START, source pattern, SEP, distractors, START, exact copy
attention_reference: 3 learned heads; width/depth matched; more parameters than fixed relation models
optimizer: AdamW default weight decay .01; lr 1e-3, linear 150-step warmup, linear decay to 1e-4; clip 1
precision: CUDA float16 autocast and GradScaler, float32 weights
primary_selection: Final step only; fixed 512 sequences per case; same training stream per seed across arms
